entries.name: Two eggs on wholegrain toast with chickpea spread and Corale baked beans
entries.quantity: 2 large eggs, 2 slices wholegrain toast (assumed), ~20 g chickpea spread (assumed), 90 g Corale baked beans
entries.notes: Corale beans scaled from photographed label: 90 g = 72 kcal, 4.1 g protein, 9.7 g carbs, 0.6 g fat, 6.1 g fibre, 3.7 g sugar. Eggs/toast/spread are estimates; toast type and chickpea spread weight not confirmed. Added sugar unknown.

entries.name: Iced protein coffee with almond milk
entries.quantity: 150 mL Inner Goodness Original almond milk (assumed), 1 espresso shot, 1 scoop chocolate whey protein
entries.notes: Standard protein coffee using almond milk instead of full-cream milk; assumes 150 mL almond milk and usual whey scoop. Macro estimates, added sugar not confirmed.
